weekly_theme.summary: 這段期間沒有特別重大的星象事件，是適合按自己步調安排生活的一週。

aries.horoscope: 牡羊座，你可能會發現自己對一個不認同你的動力和抱負的朋友或伴侶感到有點惱火。當前的宇宙氛圍凸顯了你追求目標和取得成功的充滿活力的方式。與那些看起來比較被動或猶豫不決的人相處可能會很困難。請記住，每個人都有適合自己的道路和方法。培養耐心會對你有好處。
aries.horoscope_en: Aries, you might find yourself feeling a bit exasperated with a friend or partner who doesn't share your drive and ambition. The current cosmic vibes highlight your energetic approach to pursuing your goals and attaining success. It may be challenging to relate to those who seem more passive or hesitant. Remember, everyone has their own path and methods that work for them. Cultivating patience will serve you well.
aries.lucky_disclaimer: 幸運色／幸運時間由本 App 依星座與日期自動生成，非真實命理來源，僅供參考娛樂。

taurus.horoscope: 金牛座，考慮利用你與朋友和家人的牢固聯繫來啟動一些令人興奮的集體活動。你可能會精神抖擻，社交活動的想法很誘人。如果可以的話，考慮舉辦晚宴或遊戲之夜。如果您精力充沛，參加一些運動可能是保持活力的最佳方式。優先考慮享受美好時光並安全地享受戶外活動！
taurus.horoscope_en: Taurus, consider leveraging your strong connections with friends and family to kickstart some exciting group activities. You're likely in high spirits, and the thought of socializing is enticing. Think about hosting a dinner or a game night when you can. If you're bursting with energy, engaging in some sports could be the perfect way to get active. Prioritize having a good time and enjoy the outdoors safely!
taurus.lucky_disclaimer: 幸運色／幸運時間由本 App 依星座與日期自動生成，非真實命理來源，僅供參考娛樂。

gemini.horoscope: 雙子座，如果您還沒有建立一致的運動習慣，今天就是開始的絕佳機會！請記住，保持活躍並不一定是一件苦差事或讓您感到精疲力竭。散步或練習瑜伽等簡單的活動對您的健康大有裨益。考慮從事一項讓您興奮的運動，因為它將樂趣與健身融為一體。跳舞也是一種很好的運動方式。發現什麼能引起您的共鳴，並使其成為您一天的一部分！
gemini.horoscope_en: Gemini, if you haven't established a consistent workout routine yet, today is the perfect opportunity to start! Remember, staying active doesn't have to be a chore or leave you feeling drained. Simple activities like walking or practicing yoga can be wonderful for your well-being. Consider engaging in a sport that excites you, as it blends enjoyment with fitness. Dancing is also a superb way to get moving. Discover what resonates with you and make it a part of your day!
gemini.lucky_disclaimer: 幸運色／幸運時間由本 App 依星座與日期自動生成，非真實命理來源，僅供參考娛樂。

cancer.horoscope: 今天是將你的雄心壯志轉化為具體行動的完美日子，巨蟹座。當前的行星影響增強了你的能量和樂觀情緒，是時候朝著你的願望大步前進了。請記住，除非你採取主動，否則夢想就只是夢想。時間過得真快，你不想發現自己後來還在思考「如果」。對自己的能力充滿信心並採取必要的步驟。每一次旅程都從關鍵的第一步開始。
cancer.horoscope_en: Today is the perfect day to channel your ambition into tangible actions, Cancer. With the current planetary influences boosting your energy and optimism, it's time to make strides toward your aspirations. Remember, dreams remain just that unless you take initiative. Time flies, and you don’t want to find yourself later pondering the "what ifs." Have faith in your abilities and take the necessary steps forward. Every journey begins with that crucial first move.

leo.horoscope: 今天，獅子座，抓住機會投入新項目或製定令人興奮的計劃，而不必事後懷疑自己。你的能量水平的提高將增強你自然的組織能力，為應對任何挑戰創造一個理想的場景。記下你的目標以保持專注。這也是整理雜物的好時機——丟掉不再對你有用的物品。考慮捐贈它們；很可能有人可以真正從你不再需要的東西中受益。
leo.horoscope_en: Today, Leo, embrace the opportunity to dive into new projects or make exciting plans without second-guessing yourself. Your heightened energy levels will enhance your natural ability to organize, creating an ideal scenario for tackling any challenge. Jot down your objectives to maintain your focus. It's also a great time to declutter—let go of items that no longer serve you. Think about donating them; there’s likely someone out there who could truly benefit from what you no longer need.

virgo.horoscope: 今天對你來說是光明的，處女座！你可能會體驗到能量的湧動和更清晰的前景，尤其是在你的職業生涯中。利用這種重煥活力的精神，結束所有拖延的項目或整理你的工作空間。相信您有效解決任務的能力。一旦您檢查清單上的所有內容，請不要忘記騰出一些時間來享受樂趣——這是您應得的！
virgo.horoscope_en: Today is looking bright for you, Virgo! You’re likely to experience a surge of energy and a clearer outlook, particularly in your professional life. Take advantage of this revitalized spirit by wrapping up any lingering projects or tidying up your workspace. Trust in your ability to tackle tasks efficiently. Once you've checked everything off your list, don’t forget to carve out some time for fun—you’ve earned it!

libra.horoscope: 天秤座，今天是充滿創意和野心的一天！考慮利用這種充滿活力的能量進行藝術創作，或者您可能更願意將其用於整理您的家庭或工作空間。只要稍作規劃，您就可以輕鬆找到時間來沉迷於這兩種追求。擁抱這一天，讓它變得有意義！
libra.horoscope_en: Libra, today is a day brimming with creativity and ambition! Consider harnessing this vibrant energy for an artistic endeavor, or perhaps you’d prefer to direct it towards tidying up your home or workspace. With a little planning, you can easily find time to indulge in both pursuits. Embrace the day and make it count!

scorpio.horoscope: 天蠍座，準備好今天感到精力充沛吧！你可能會體驗到身體活力的激增，給你充足的能量。這是一個絕佳的機會來從事任何需要一定體力的任務。無論是修理房子周圍的東西還是重新佈置家具，甚至去健身房，抓住每一天並充滿熱情地對待它！
scorpio.horoscope_en: Prepare to feel invigorated today, Scorpio! You’re likely to experience a surge of physical vitality, giving you plenty of energy to spare. It’s an excellent opportunity to dive into any tasks that demand some muscle power. Whether it’s fixing things around the house or rearranging furniture, or even hitting the gym, seize the day and approach it with enthusiasm!

sagittarius.horoscope: 當前的行星排列將擺脫你所經歷的任何遲緩，射手座。今天非常適合戶外活動和參與一些體育活動。考慮將您的精力和創造力投入園藝或景觀美化專案中。新鮮空氣和運動的結合將為您的健康創造奇蹟。請記住，即使今天需要工作，晚上也是您放鬆和享受的時間。
sagittarius.horoscope_en: The current planetary alignments are set to shake off any sluggishness you've been experiencing, Sagittarius. Today is perfect for stepping outdoors and engaging in some physical activity. Consider channeling your energy and creativity into gardening or landscaping projects. The combination of fresh air and movement will do wonders for your well-being. And remember, even if work calls today, the evening is yours to unwind and relish.

capricorn.horoscope: 摩羯座，今天是優先考慮健康的完美日子。你可能會帶著一股能量崛起，所以利用天體排列帶來的這種活力來從事增強你的健康的活動。不要忘記培養您的情感和精神健康。花一些時間在戶外，呼吸新鮮空氣，散步，照顧花園，或投入創意和運動項目。
capricorn.horoscope_en: Capricorn, today is the perfect day to prioritize your health. You may rise with a surge of energy, so harness this vitality brought on by the celestial alignments to engage in activities that enhance your well-being. Don't forget to nurture your emotional and spiritual health as well. Spend some time outdoors, breathe in the fresh air, take a stroll, tend to your garden, or dive into a creative and physical project.

aquarius.horoscope: 如果你在工藝品店或藝術工作室發現了一些吸引你眼球但超出預算的東西，為什麼不嘗試自己創作呢，水瓶座？即使您不認為自己是藝術家，您可能會對自己的創造力感到驚訝。有大量資源可供初學者使用，可以提供指導和支援。不要低估你的潛力－抓住這個機會，發現新的創意出路。
aquarius.horoscope_en: If you've spotted something in a craft store or art studio that catches your eye but is out of your budget, why not try creating it yourself, Aquarius? You might be surprised by your own creativity, even if you don't see yourself as an artist. There are plenty of resources available for beginners that can provide guidance and support. Don't underestimate your potential—dive into this opportunity and discover a new creative outlet.

pisces.horoscope: 雙魚座，今天是您擁抱戶外活動的理想日子。您會發現自己充滿了積極性和活力，這是吸收新鮮空氣和陽光的好時機——這是您可能一直錯過的。如果你的工作讓你待在室內，請把握休息和午餐時間到戶外活動的機會。晚上晚些時候，如果有機會，請考慮與朋友聚會。
pisces.horoscope_en: Today is an ideal day for you to embrace the outdoors, Pisces. You'll find yourself brimming with positivity and energy, making it a great time to soak up some fresh air and sunshine—something you may have been missing. If your work keeps you indoors, seize the chance to step outside during your breaks and lunch to stretch your legs. Later in the evening, consider gathering with friends if the opportunity arises.
